paper.title: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Recursive Self-Verification
paper.summary: We propose recursive self-verification, a method that lets language models check their own reasoning chains. Across math and code benchmarks it improves accuracy by 12 points at equal compute. We release code and models.

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Recursive Self-Verification

paper.title: OmniAgent: A Generalist Multimodal Agent for Computer Use
paper.summary: OmniAgent unifies vision-language perception with tool use for desktop and web tasks. It reaches state-of-the-art on OSWorld and WebArena.

title: OmniAgent: A Generalist Multimodal Agent for Computer Use

paper.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Kernels for Efficient Inference
paper.summary: We present fused kernels for sparse MoE inference achieving 2.3x throughput on H100 GPUs.

title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Kernels for Efficient Inference

paper.title: A Survey of Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper.summary: We survey reward hacking phenomena in RLHF and propose a taxonomy of mitigations for alignment.

title: A Survey of Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

paper.title: Tiny Tweaks to Positional Encodings
paper.summary: We study minor changes to rotary embeddings.
